c1.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
c1.descriptionRaw:
The maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> additionally creates 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>.
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.
c1.description:
The maximum number of **Gradient Beacons** Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection additionally creates 1 Gradient Beacon.
While the **Detection Core** is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a Gradient Beacon is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

c2.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness
c2.descriptionRaw:
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, all opponents within the <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.
c2.description:
While the **Detection Core** is present, all opponents within the Polestar Field have their Cryo RES and Electro RES decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the Detection Core created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.

c3.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology
c3.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11362}<color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c3.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill **Principle: Variable Detection** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: The Isotopes Born of Decay
c4.descriptionRaw: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Cores{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
c4.description: **Detection Cores** created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 **Gradient Beacons** consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

c5.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All
c5.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: {LINK#S11361}<color=#FFD780FF>Chain Reaction</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c5.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: **Chain Reaction** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason
c6.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is enhanced. If the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>:
 · Is in the Steady State: <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> deals 115% of its original DMG.
· Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> whenever Mitya consumes a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> with the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11190007}Elevated{/LINK}</color> by 20%.
c6.description:
**Detection Core** is enhanced. If the Detection Core:

Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is **Elevated** by 20%.
